exposure: timing of early antiretroviral treatment initiation (3 vs. 5 days post-SHIV exposure)
outcome: virus-specific immunity (neutralizing antibodies, cytotoxic T cell responses, antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity)
cohort: The study participants were postnatally SHIV-exposed infant macaques.
finding: Early treatment initiation is a critical determinant of virologic control in HIV-exposed, infected infants, with earlier initiation leading to higher rates of sustained virologic remission.
